extension.summary: Play your videos, music and pictures from Dropbox
extension.description: Browse your Dropbox in Kodi and play your videos, music and pictures. - Any number of Dropbox accounts - Search your Dropbox - Shared with me: folders and files others share with you - Subtitles stored next to your videos are loaded automatically - Export videos and music to the Kodi library (.strm files) - Use Dropbox as a source - Read-only: the add-on never changes or deletes your files Sign in from your phone or computer with a short code shown in Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not affiliated with or endorsed by Dropbox.
extension.summary: Reproduce tus videos, música e imágenes de Dropbox
extension.description: Explora tu Dropbox en Kodi y reproduce tus videos, música e imágenes. - Cualquier número de cuentas de Dropbox - Busca en tu Dropbox - Compartido contigo: carpetas y archivos que otros comparten contigo - Los subtítulos guardados junto a tus videos se cargan automáticamente - Exporta videos y música a la biblioteca de Kodi (archivos .strm) - Usa Dropbox como fuente - Solo lectura: el complemento nunca cambia ni elimina tus archivos Inicia sesión desde tu teléfono o computadora con un código corto que muestra Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: Este complemento no está afiliado a Dropbox ni cuenta con su respaldo.
extension.summary: Reproduza seus vídeos, músicas e imagens do Dropbox
extension.description: Navegue pelo seu Dropbox no Kodi e reproduza seus vídeos, músicas e imagens. - Qualquer número de contas do Dropbox - Pesquise no seu Dropbox - Compartilhados com você: pastas e arquivos que outras pessoas compartilham com você - As legendas salvas junto aos seus vídeos são carregadas automaticamente - Exporte vídeos e músicas para a biblioteca do Kodi (arquivos .strm) - Use o Dropbox como fonte - Somente leitura: o add-on nunca altera nem exclui seus arquivos Entre na conta pelo celular ou computador com um código curto mostrado no Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: Este add-on não é afiliado ao Dropbox nem endossado por ele.
extension.summary: Spela upp dina videor, din musik och dina bilder från Dropbox
extension.description: Bläddra i din Dropbox i Kodi och spela upp dina videor, din musik och dina bilder. - Valfritt antal Dropbox-konton - Sök i din Dropbox - Delat med mig: mappar och filer som andra delar med dig - Undertexter som sparats bredvid dina videor läses in automatiskt - Exportera videor och musik till Kodi-biblioteket (.strm-filer) - Använd Dropbox som källa - Endast läsning: tillägget ändrar eller tar aldrig bort dina filer Logga in från din telefon eller dator med en kort kod som visas i Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: Det här tillägget är inte anslutet till eller godkänt av Dropbox.
extension.news:
v1.0.11 released Oct 31, 2026: - Videos show the plot, cast and artwork of the Kodi .nfo files and pictures next to them (it can be turned off in the settings) - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.18
v1.0.10 released Oct 31, 2026: - The add-on's forum link goes to its thread in the Kodi forum
v1.0.9 released Oct 31, 2026: - Each account opens a menu, as in Google Drive and OneDrive: Files, Shared with me, Exports and Search - Shared with me: folders and files others share with you, even those not added to your Dropbox. Accounts added before this version need to be added again to see them - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.13
v1.0.8 released Oct 30, 2026: - Big folders open a page at a time: Items per page in the Advanced settings (500 by default, 0 for the whole folder) - Going back to a folder, after viewing a picture for example, doesn't load it again for a few minutes (Cache expiration time) - Auto-refreshed slideshow for pictures, as in Google Drive and OneDrive - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.13
v1.0.7 released Oct 24, 2026: - The remove dialog says revoking only signs out this Kodi - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.11
v1.0.6 released Oct 24, 2026: - Removing an account can also revoke the add-on's access to your Dropbox account - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.10
